requirements.title: Double-entry bookkeeping journal entries
requirements.description: Every transaction must consist of balanced debit and credit entries summing strictly to zero.

requirements.title: Optimistic concurrency control on account balances
requirements.description: Prevent concurrent double-spending via row-level balance versioning.

requirements.title: Idempotent transaction submission
requirements.description: Clients supply an Idempotency-Key; duplicate submissions must return original result without re-executing.

requirements.title: Multi-tenant tenant isolation
requirements.description: Data strictly isolated by tenant_id across all storage queries and API endpoints.

requirements.title: Audit log and immutable transaction history
requirements.description: Append-only ledger journal with cryptographic checksum chaining.

product_invariants.title: Zero-Sum Conservation Law
product_invariants.rule: Sum of debits must equal sum of credits for every posted journal batch.

product_invariants.title: Non-Negative Available Balance
product_invariants.rule: Account balance cannot drop below zero unless explicitly configured with credit line.

product_invariants.title: Immutability of Posted Entries
product_invariants.rule: Posted ledger entries can never be modified or deleted; corrections require offsetting reversal entries.

entities.name: LedgerAccount
entities.description: Represents an individual balance account within a tenant domain.

entities.name: JournalBatch
entities.description: Atomic transaction containing paired debit and credit postings.

entities.name: PostingEntry
entities.description: Individual debit or credit leg linked to a ledger account.
